note: Where each hung council is leaning before its mayoral vote, based on news reports. lean: -2 likely A, -1 lean A, 0 toss-up, 1 lean B, 2 likely B. Bloc seats are counted from the council results.

JHB.why: Reports say the ANC, ActionSA, EFF and MK have agreed a pact that would make ActionSA’s Herman Mashaba mayor. Councillors were sworn in on Monday but voted to postpone the mayoral election to later this week.
src: No new mayor for Joburg as vote postponed
ANC rejects ActionSA offer to accommodate regional chair Loyiso Masuku as PR councillor
Mashaba set for Joburg mayoralty as ANC, ActionSA, MK and EFF seal metro pact

TSH.why: The ANC has reportedly offered ActionSA the Tshwane mayoralty, and ActionSA says any deal must keep Nasiphi Moya as mayor. ActionSA turned down the DA’s final offer. The new council sits on Thursday.
src: Tshwane coalition talks intensify ahead of Thursday council sitting
ANC offers ActionSA Joburg and Tshwane mayoral seats, keeps Ekurhuleni in coalition deal
ActionSA’s power-sharing offer to the DA rejected as Gauteng coalition talks turn bitter

EKU.why: Under the ANC’s reported offer to ActionSA, the ANC would keep Ekurhuleni. No Ekurhuleni deal has been reported as signed.
src: ANC offers ActionSA Joburg and Tshwane mayoral seats, keeps Ekurhuleni in coalition deal
FF Plus fails to broker DA-ActionSA coalition after deadlocked Gauteng talks

ETH.why: IOL reports the ANC and MK have sealed an eThekwini deal, and a source says MK will take the mayoralty with ActionSA as deputy mayor and the ANC as speaker. KZN Cogta has ordered the first council meeting postponed; the city says it will go ahead.
src: eThekwini insists council meeting will go ahead despite KZN Cogta’s postponement order
MK Party tipped for eThekwini mayor as coalition talks near conclusion
ANC and MK Party seal eThekwini coalition deal as ActionSA’s future hangs in balance

NMA.why: Analysts say the DA holds the upper hand, the DA in the Eastern Cape says a deal is near the finish line, and ActionSA says it will back the DA’s mayoral candidate. No deal has been reported as signed.
src: ActionSA says it doesn’t have a problem working with DA
DA Eastern Cape ‘very pleased’ as Nelson Mandela Bay coalition deal nears finish line
DA holds upper hand in Nelson Mandela Bay coalition talks, analysts say

BUF.why: News24 reports the ANC is close to a deal with the EFF and SACP, while the UDM courts a wider bloc of its own.
src: UDM courts wider coalition bloc in Buffalo City, as ANC nears deal with EFF, SACP

MAN.why: The ANC and DA are one seat apart, and no deal has been reported yet.
src: ANC loses outright control of Mangaung for the first time as DA nips at its heels
